editions.title: CR7 Edition
editions.headline: The Entire World Cup Legacy of *CR7*, Immortalized in Gold Foil for Your Wall
editions.subheadline: Six World Cups, from Germany 2006 to North America 2026, in one framed shadow box with gold foil accents. Arrives ready to hang.
editions.story: From his first World Cup in Germany in 2006 to becoming the first man to score at five World Cups in Qatar 2022, every chapter of Cristiano Ronaldo’s international journey sits in order inside one frame.

cards.label: DEBUT
cards.description: His first World Cup. He scored against Iran in Frankfurt as Portugal reached their first semi-final in 40 years.

cards.label: CAPTAIN
cards.description: His first World Cup as Portugal captain.

cards.label: BALLON D’OR
cards.description: Arrived as the reigning Ballon d’Or winner, set up a late equaliser against the USA in Manaus and scored the winner against Ghana in Brasília.

cards.label: SOCHI HAT-TRICK
cards.description: Scored a hat-trick against Spain in Sochi, finishing with a late free kick to make it 3–3.

cards.label: FIVE WORLD CUPS
cards.description: Scored against Ghana to become the first man to score at five World Cups.

cards.label: SIXTH WORLD CUP
cards.description: The 2026 World Cup, hosted across the USA, Canada and Mexico.

editions.title: Lionel Messi Edition
editions.headline: Every Era of *Messi’s* World Cup Story, Framed in Gold Foil
editions.subheadline: Six World Cups, from his debut in Germany 2006 to North America 2026, in one framed shadow box with gold foil accents.
editions.quote: "From an 18-year-old debut to lifting the trophy in Lusail."
editions.story: From his first World Cup goal at 18 in Germany to two Golden Balls and Argentina’s third star in Qatar, every chapter of Lionel Messi’s World Cup journey sits in order inside one frame.

cards.label: DEBUT
cards.description: His first World Cup. At 18 he scored against Serbia and Montenegro, becoming Argentina’s youngest World Cup scorer.

cards.label: NO. 10
cards.description: His first World Cup in Argentina’s No. 10 shirt.

cards.label: GOLDEN BALL
cards.description: Led Argentina to the final at the Maracanã and won the tournament’s Golden Ball.

cards.label: ST PETERSBURG
cards.description: Scored against Nigeria in St Petersburg to help send Argentina through to the knockout stage.

cards.label: WORLD CHAMPION
cards.description: Scored twice in the final, won the World Cup with Argentina and collected a second Golden Ball.

cards.label: SIXTH WORLD CUP
cards.description: The 2026 World Cup, hosted across the USA, Canada and Mexico.

editions.title: Neymar Jr Edition
editions.headline: The World Cup Artistry of *Neymar Jr*, Framed in Gold Foil
editions.subheadline: From Brazil 2014 to North America 2026, four World Cups in one framed shadow box with gold foil accents.
editions.story: From carrying a host nation’s hopes at Brazil 2014 to equalling Pelé’s Brazil scoring record in Qatar, all four of Neymar Jr’s World Cups sit in order inside one frame.

cards.label: HOST NATION
cards.description: His first World Cup, at home. He scored twice in the opening match against Croatia in São Paulo and twice more against Cameroon in Brasília.

cards.label: SAMARA
cards.description: Scored and set up a goal against Mexico in Samara to take Brazil into the quarter-finals.

cards.label: PELÉ’S RECORD
cards.description: Scored in extra time against Croatia to equal Pelé’s record of 77 goals for Brazil.

cards.label: LAST DANCE
cards.description: The 2026 World Cup, hosted across the USA, Canada and Mexico.
